entities.summary: General Sir Evelyn Hugh Barker, was a British Army officer who saw service in both the First World War and the Second World War. During the latter, he commanded the 10th Brigade during the Battle of France in 1940, the 49th Infantry Division and the VIII Corps in the Western Europe Campaign from 1944 to 1945.
